entities.summary: Yangcheng Lake is a freshwater lake in Suzhou, Jiangsu province, China, about 3 km (1.9 mi) northeast of the city center. The lake is 17 km (11 mi) long from north to south, with an average width of 8 km (5.0 mi) from east to west, a surface area of about 20 km2 (7.7 sq mi), and ranges in depth from 1.5–2 m.
